finding: Explicit available-frame SGNify endpoint has 57 clips and 1493 frames at 15 fps; legacy arithmetic 2872 uses a different endpoint interpretation.
decision: Freeze explicit frame IDs and reject intersection-only evaluation.

finding: Ablehnen was observed during coordinate smoke debugging before split freeze.
decision: Quarantine Ablehnen to development; clean confirmatory test has 24 clips and 655 frames.

finding: Legacy camera-X export transform and MANO fingertip mapping materially change metrics.
decision: Canonicalize x/y/z convention and use an explicit 21-to-16 joint map; invalidate earlier caches/results.

finding: Absolute-camera residual and hard sigma clipping invalidated initial uncertainty training.
decision: Use pelvis translation-aligned residual, bounded differentiable sigma, and clip-disjoint model-fit/conformal subsets.

finding: No reliable contact labels or frozen semantic evaluator are available.
decision: Evaluate contact only on synthetic/proximity diagnostics and block contact-correctness/semantic claims.

finding: Hard uncertainty gating by joint or region creates kinematically inconsistent trees and underperforms the coherent legacy-full control.
decision: Use coherent full-pose initialization; retain uncertainty for soft factors, risk and abstention rather than hard tree splicing.

finding: M1 development improves left-hand TR-V2V by 0.695 mm (95% CI -1.210 to -0.198) and all dynamics endpoints while body/right remain within 0.01 mm.
decision: Pass G3 and preregister M1 versus legacy-full/fallback for clean confirmatory test.

finding: Synthetic M2 mean frame/event contact F1 is 0.859/0.944, but one sequence has a four-frame sticky offset and no reliable real labels exist.
decision: Keep M2 exploratory and exclude contact correctness from confirmatory claims.

finding: Warm-started M2 has zero active contact and penetration proxy on development; it improves dynamics but regresses left-hand TR-V2V by 0.111 mm versus M1 (95% CI -0.117 to +0.344).
decision: Fail G5, retain M2 as exploratory, and keep M1 as the preregistered confirmatory candidate.

finding: Frozen M1 test improves legacy/fallback dynamics with all 95% CIs below zero and preserves body/right geometry, but left-hand TR-V2V changes by only -0.204 mm (95% CI -0.691 to +0.269).
decision: Pass coverage, reproducibility, dynamics and non-inferiority gates; fail registered hand-superiority/effect gate and prohibit an overall SOTA claim.

finding: Post-test source audit found that cache v2 omitted WiLoR's required canonical-right to SMPL-X-left 3D/rotation reflection, although the read-only legacy parser applies it explicitly.
decision: Classify v1 confirmatory geometry as invalidated by a software convention bug; preserve it, make no hyperparameter changes, and rerun cache, calibration, M0, legacy/fallback, M1, evaluation and bootstrap from scratch under a new freeze.

finding: The Phase-2 A1 ordering uses a different left-hand availability mask; under SIGNAL-4D all-sign clip-macro evaluation, pinned Ensemble is strongest on body/right while pinned Biomech is 0.0620 mm lower on left. The earlier one-step baseline also used clip-mean rather than per-frame shape.
decision: Retain pre-frozen balanced Ensemble+A0 as primary A1, add Biomech+A0 as strongest-left sensitivity control, materialize both with per-frame shape and the pinned model, invalidate the partial post-segment Biomech-only run, and fit the exact Ensemble configuration before reading prospective GT.

finding: The corrected v3 rerun removed the left-MANO convention bug but changed left-hand TR-V2V by only -0.2035 mm versus the frozen legacy/fallback control (95% CI -0.7080 to +0.2800); dynamics improved.
decision: Fail the original superiority gate, make no SOTA claim from the revealed central test, and use it only as historical development evidence for a separately preregistered prospective endpoint.

finding: A GT-free multiscale gate trained with grouped out-of-fold historical selection achieved -0.9872 mm clip-macro left-hand delta (95% clip-bootstrap CI -1.4238 to -0.5696) across 45 clips/1233 frames with zero within-clip switches.
decision: Freeze the gate forests, hypotheses, 8 mm transition cost and safe serialization before prospective fitting; prohibit prospective-label inputs or retuning on the extended-post endpoint.

finding: Filename-only availability checks showed that the balanced Ensemble fitter and original-HaMeR fallback can each lack valid frames on the prospective tail, while raw SMPLer-X is available for every declared frame.
decision: Freeze a per-frame availability hierarchy of Ensemble A1, then HaMeR A0, then raw SMPLer-X A0 terminal fallback; report exact source counts and require 100% coverage without reading GT geometry.

finding: On the release-frozen 56-clip/769-frame prospective extended-post endpoint, SIGNAL-4D v5 improved left-hand TR-V2V by 2.1411 mm versus balanced A1 (paired 95% clip-bootstrap CI 1.4191 to 2.9547 mm improvement), improved upper body and all dynamics endpoints, preserved right-hand geometry, achieved 100% coverage, and reproduced byte-exactly.
decision: Pass every preregistered gate and permit the scoped claim of a new best result on the prospective SIGNAL-4D extended-post SGNify endpoint versus the pre-frozen recomputed same-protocol A1 baseline; explicitly prohibit external-leaderboard, unseen-signer, contact-correctness, or semantic-fidelity generalization.
